responsibility: Implements per-insn reload analysis for the legacy reload pass. It scans RTL patterns to discover operands, addresses, and autoincrement forms that must be copied into suitable hard registers; records reload requirements, replacements, earlyclobber interactions, secondary reload needs, and optional/equivalent alternatives; and provides helper predicates and debugging dumps used by reload1.cc. This file decides what reloads an insn needs, while reload1.cc manages whole-function spill/reload execution.
same_name_distinction: This source implements legacy reload’s per-insn analysis logic such as find_reloads, reload discovery, replacement recording, and related helpers. The same-stem header gcc/reload.h is the broader contract header that shares reload data structures, enums, and APIs with reload1.cc, caller-save code, and the rest of the backend.
